epics.title: Project Setup & Foundation
epics.description: Initial setup of the project environment, repositories, and foundational tools.

tasks.title: Initialize Git repository and define branching strategy
tasks.description: Setup Git, .gitignore, and document branching model (e.g., GitFlow).

tasks.title: Setup Python backend project structure (FastAPI/Flask)
tasks.description: Create initial directories, virtual environment, and basic app setup.

tasks.title: Setup React frontend project structure (Create React App or Vite)
tasks.description: Initialize React project, setup basic folder structure for components, services, etc.

tasks.title: Configure linters and formatters (ESLint, Prettier, Flake8, Black)
tasks.description: Setup and configure linting and formatting tools for both frontend and backend.

tasks.title: Setup initial CI/CD pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions)
tasks.description: Basic pipeline for running linters and tests on push/PR.

epics.title: Backend Core: GRBL Communication & API
epics.description: Development of the core backend functionalities including GRBL communication, API endpoints, and database interaction.

tasks.title: Implement GRBL connection module
tasks.description: Develop backend module for listing available serial ports, connecting to a GRBL device, and disconnecting. Handle connection errors.

tasks.title: Develop GRBL command sending and response parsing logic
tasks.description: Implement functionality to send G-code commands and GRBL specific commands (e.g., '$$', '$I') to the connected device and parse 'ok'/error responses.

tasks.title: Implement GRBL real-time status reporting parser
tasks.description: Develop logic to continuously parse real-time status reports (e.g., from '?') and other unsolicited messages from GRBL (e.g., alarms, feedback messages).

tasks.title: Design and implement database models
tasks.description: Implement database models (Machine, Project, File, Setting) using an ORM like SQLAlchemy, based on the database_schema.md. Include Pydantic models for validation.

tasks.title: Develop API endpoints for Machine configuration (CRUD)
tasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting machine configurations as defined in api_specification.md.

tasks.title: Develop API endpoints for Project management (CRUD)
tasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting projects as defined in api_specification.md.

tasks.title: Implement WebSocket endpoint for real-time updates
tasks.description: Develop a WebSocket endpoint to stream GRBL status, console messages, and other real-time data to the frontend.

tasks.title: Develop a mock/simulated GRBL controller for testing
tasks.description: Create a Python-based GRBL simulator that can mimic basic GRBL responses to commands and status queries. This will be essential for backend and E2E testing without a physical device.

epics.title: Frontend Core: UI/UX & State Management
epics.description: Development of the core frontend UI components, user experience, and state management.

tasks.title: Setup global state management (e.g., Zustand or Redux Toolkit)
tasks.description: Choose and implement a global state management solution for handling application-wide state like connection status, machine state, and user settings.

tasks.title: Implement basic application layout
tasks.description: Develop the main application layout components: Header (for branding/navigation), Sidebar (for main controls/navigation), Main Content Area, and a Footer/Status Bar.

tasks.title: Setup routing for main application views
tasks.description: Implement client-side routing (e.g., using React Router) for navigating between different sections of the application (e.g., Dashboard, Machine Control, File Management, Settings).

tasks.title: Implement UI theme and styling
tasks.description: Choose and implement a UI component library (e.g., Material-UI, Ant Design) or a styling approach (e.g., Tailwind CSS, Styled Components). Define a consistent theme (colors, typography, spacing).

tasks.title: Develop reusable UI components
tasks.description: Create a library of common reusable UI components such as Buttons, InputFields, Modals, Notifications/Toasts, Loaders, etc., based on the chosen styling approach.

tasks.title: Implement WebSocket client for real-time communication
tasks.description: Develop a service or hook to establish and manage the WebSocket connection to the backend for receiving real-time updates (GRBL status, console messages). Integrate with global state.

tasks.title: Create initial API service layer for frontend-backend communication
tasks.description: Develop a set of functions/services to handle HTTP requests to the backend API endpoints (e.g., using Axios or fetch). Manage request/response handling and error states.

epics.title: Feature: Machine Connection & Control
epics.description: Implementing features related to connecting to the GRBL machine and basic controls.

tasks.title: Develop UI for machine connection
tasks.description: Create UI components for selecting serial port, baud rate, and initiating/terminating connection to the GRBL device. Display connection status.

tasks.title: Implement UI for displaying real-time machine status
tasks.description: Develop UI components to display real-time machine status (e.g., Idle, Run, Hold, Alarm), work position (WPos), machine position (MPos), and feed/spindle rates received via WebSocket.

tasks.title: Develop UI for console output and command input
tasks.description: Create a console-like UI to display messages from GRBL and allow users to send manual G-code commands. Include command history.

tasks.title: Implement Jogging controls UI
tasks.description: Develop UI components for jogging the machine along X, Y, and Z axes with configurable step sizes and feed rates. Remember the 0,0 is top-right.

tasks.title: Implement 'Set Zero' (G92 or G10 L20 P0 X0 Y0 Z0) and 'Go to Zero' functionality
tasks.description: Develop UI buttons and backend logic to set the current work position as zero for X, Y, Z and to command the machine to go to this work zero.

tasks.title: Implement Homing ($H), Unlock ($X), and Reset (Ctrl+X) commands UI
tasks.description: Develop UI buttons to send homing, unlock, and software reset commands to the GRBL device.

tasks.title: Develop UI for viewing and editing GRBL settings ($$)
tasks.description: Create a UI to display GRBL settings fetched via '$$' command and allow users to edit and save them (e.g., $0=10).

epics.title: Feature: File Management & G-code Processing
epics.description: Implementing features for managing files, converting images to G-code, and processing G-code.

tasks.title: Backend: API endpoints for File (G-code/Image) upload and management (CRUD)
tasks.description: Develop API endpoints for uploading G-code and image files. Store file metadata in the database (File model) and files on the server or cloud storage. Implement list, retrieve, delete.

tasks.title: Frontend: UI for file uploading and management
tasks.description: Create UI components for users to upload G-code or image files. Display a list of uploaded files, allow selection, and deletion. Associate files with projects.

tasks.title: Backend: G-code streaming and job control logic
tasks.description: Implement backend logic to stream a selected G-code file line-by-line to the GRBL device. Handle 'ok'/error responses, manage the send queue, and implement pause/resume/stop job commands.

tasks.title: Frontend: UI for G-code job control
tasks.description: Develop UI components to start, pause, resume, and stop a G-code job. Display job progress (e.g., line number, percentage complete).

tasks.title: Backend: Image-to-G-code conversion module
tasks.description: Research and implement a Python library or custom logic for converting uploaded images (e.g., PNG, JPG, SVG) into G-code. Allow basic parameter configuration (e.g., scale, feed rate, laser power for engraving).

tasks.title: Frontend: UI for image-to-G-code conversion settings
tasks.description: Create UI components for users to configure parameters for image-to-G-code conversion and initiate the process.

tasks.title: Backend: API endpoint for initiating image-to-G-code conversion
tasks.description: Develop an API endpoint that takes an image ID and conversion parameters, triggers the conversion process, and saves the resulting G-code.

epics.title: Feature: Visualizer & Job Simulation
epics.description: Developing the G-code visualizer and job simulation capabilities.

tasks.title: Research G-code visualization libraries (e.g., three.js, p5.js, or existing G-code viewers)
tasks.description: Investigate suitable JavaScript libraries for rendering G-code paths in a 2D or 3D view. Consider performance with large G-code files.

tasks.title: Backend: G-code parsing for visualization
tasks.description: Develop a Python module to parse G-code files and extract tool path coordinates (X, Y, Z movements), feed rates, and other relevant information for visualization.

tasks.title: Backend: API endpoint to provide parsed G-code data for visualizer
tasks.description: Create an API endpoint that takes a file ID and returns the parsed G-code data in a format suitable for the chosen frontend visualization library.

tasks.title: Frontend: Implement G-code visualizer component
tasks.description: Develop a React component that uses the chosen library to render the G-code tool paths. Include basic controls like zoom, pan, and rotate (if 3D). Display on a grid (20mm steps, 0,0 top-right).

tasks.title: Frontend: Implement job simulation in visualizer
tasks.description: Enhance the visualizer to show the tool's progress in real-time (or simulated time) as the G-code job runs or is simulated. Highlight the current G-code line being processed.

tasks.title: Frontend: Allow placement and scaling of loaded G-code/images on the visualizer grid
tasks.description: Implement functionality to drag, drop, and scale the visual representation of the G-code or image on the work area grid before starting a job.

epics.title: Testing & Quality Assurance
epics.description: Writing and executing tests (Unit, Integration, E2E) and ensuring quality.

tasks.title: Setup backend testing framework (e.g., Pytest) and write unit tests for core modules
tasks.description: Configure Pytest and write unit tests for GRBL communication logic, API utility functions, and other critical backend modules. Utilize the mock GRBL controller.

tasks.title: Write integration tests for backend API endpoints
tasks.description: Develop integration tests to verify the functionality of all major API endpoints, including request/response validation and database interactions.

tasks.title: Setup frontend testing framework (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library)
tasks.description: Configure Jest and React Testing Library for the frontend. Write unit tests for utility functions, state management logic, and API service layers.

tasks.title: Write component tests for core UI components
tasks.description: Develop component tests for reusable UI components and key feature components to ensure they render and behave as expected.

tasks.title: Setup E2E testing framework (e.g., Cypress or Playwright)
tasks.description: Configure an E2E testing framework. Write initial E2E tests for critical user flows such as machine connection, file loading, job execution, and visualization.

tasks.title: Develop a comprehensive test plan document
tasks.description: Create a document outlining the testing strategy, scope, types of tests, environments, and responsibilities for the project.

epics.title: Deployment & Documentation
epics.description: Preparing the application for deployment and creating user and developer documentation.

tasks.title: Prepare backend for production (e.g., Gunicorn/Uvicorn, environment variables)
tasks.description: Configure the backend application to run with a production-grade ASGI/WSGI server and manage configurations using environment variables.

tasks.title: Containerize backend and frontend applications (Docker)
tasks.description: Create Dockerfiles for both the backend and frontend applications to enable consistent environments and simplify deployment.

tasks.title: Setup deployment strategy (e.g., Docker Compose for local/dev, Kubernetes for prod)
tasks.description: Define and implement a deployment strategy. Start with Docker Compose for local development and testing, and plan for a more robust solution like Kubernetes if needed for production.

tasks.title: Enhance CI/CD pipeline for automated builds, tests, and deployments
tasks.description: Extend the CI/CD pipeline to include building Docker images, running all tests, and automating deployment to staging/production environments.

tasks.title: Write comprehensive user documentation (setup, usage, troubleshooting)
tasks.description: Create user-facing documentation covering application setup, how to use its features, and common troubleshooting steps. This could be in Markdown or a dedicated documentation site.

tasks.title: Write developer documentation (architecture, API, setup, contribution guidelines)
tasks.description: Create technical documentation for developers, including system architecture, API specifications, local development setup instructions, and guidelines for contributing to the project.
